SELECT d.store_id, s.currency, SUM(d.impressions) AS impressions, SUM(d.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(d.spend) AS spend, SUM(d.ad_sales) AS sales, SUM(d.ad_orders) AS orders FROM ecom_ad_daily d JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = d.store_id WHERE d.ad_date >= #{begin} AND d.ad_date <= #{end}
GROUP BY d.store_id, s.currency

SELECT r.store_id AS "storeId", COUNT(*) AS "returns" FROM ecom_return r WHERE r.create_time >= #{begin} AND r.create_time < #{end}
GROUP BY r.store_id

SELECT r.store_id, ri.seller_sku, SUM(ri.qty) AS qty, SUM(ri.refund_amount * r.exchange_rate) AS refund_base, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS returns FROM ecom_return_item ri JOIN ecom_return r ON r.id = ri.return_id WHERE r.create_time >= #{begin} AND r.create_time < #{end} AND ri.seller_sku IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.store_id, ri.seller_sku

SELECT COALESCE(r.reason, '') AS reason, COUNT(*) AS returns, COALESCE(SUM((SELECT SUM(ri.qty) FROM ecom_return_item ri WHERE ri.return_id = r.id)), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount * r.exchange_rate), 0) AS refund_base FROM ecom_return r WHERE r.create_time >= #{begin} AND r.create_time < #{end}
GROUP BY COALESCE(r.reason, '') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT r.store_id, s.name AS store_name, ri.seller_sku, COALESCE(r.reason, '') AS reason, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS returns, SUM(ri.qty) AS qty, SUM(ri.refund_amount * r.exchange_rate) AS refund_base FROM ecom_return_item ri JOIN ecom_return r ON r.id = ri.return_id JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = r.store_id WHERE r.create_time >= #{begin} AND r.create_time < #{end} AND ri.seller_sku IS NOT NULL
AND ri.seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY r.store_id, s.name, ri.seller_sku, COALESCE(r.reason, '') ORDER BY SUM(ri.qty) DESC

SELECT v.store_id, s.name AS store_name, COALESCE(v.seller_sku, '') AS seller_sku, COUNT(*) AS reviews, AVG(v.rating) AS avg_rating, SUM(CASE WHEN v.rating <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_reviews FROM ecom_review v JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = v.store_id WHERE v.review_date >= #{begin} AND v.review_date <= #{end}
AND v.seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY v.store_id, s.name, COALESCE(v.seller_sku, '') ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN v.rating <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT o.store_id, s.name AS store_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.local_status IN ('EXCEPTION', 'ON_HOLD', 'OUT_OF_STOCK') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exceptions, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ship_by < #{now} AND o.local_status IN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ship_by >= #{now} AND o.ship_by < #{dueBefore} AND o.local_status IN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS due_soon, SUM(CASE WHEN o.local_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.local_status IN
GROUP BY o.store_id, s.name ORDER BY s.name
SELECT c.id, c.store_id, s.name AS store_name, s.currency, c.name, c.status, c.daily_budget FROM ecom_ad_campaign c JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = c.store_id WHERE 1 = 1

FROM ecom_ad_daily d JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.store_id = d.store_id AND l.seller_sku = d.seller_sku JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = l.material_id WHERE d.seller_sku <> '' AND (m.id = #{materialId} OR m.template_id = #{materialId} OR (m.template_id IS NOT NULL AND m.template_id = (SELECT x.template_id FROM wms_material x WHERE x.id = #{materialId}))
OR (m.category IS NOT NULL AND m.category = (SELECT y.category FROM wms_material y WHERE y.id = #{materialId})) )
